race.comment: REDDIVO (1) has been dominating the 3000m+ scene at this level lately, a dominant winner at Warrnambool two back before a very tough win there again last time. Away from the heavy now but he's fine on better tracks and you know he'll stay it out strongly. GENRICHERO (4) hasn't won in a while but is coming along well for this, beaten half a length at Morphettville over 2500m last time out. The extra trip should be fine. SALSITA (2) is only third up going 1400-2030-3080m which is a tough ask but was very good to the line last time in a stronger race. Have to respect the stable who can produce a stayer. MIDNIGHT GLOW (5) is another unproven this trip but in the mix.
